acceptance: The blocked NI2-010 published compatibility gate may close only after the unit controls, actual injected and non-injected fault cases and source-bound review pass. The isolated unchanged 1/1 pass alone is insufficient.
acceptance_controls: Unit: one renewal HTTP500 then success replays byte/argument-identical material, does not kill the process and records one current successful renewal.
Unit: server applies renewal and the response is lost; the identical retry succeeds without identity drift.

Unit with fake monotonic clock: repeated 5xx consumes no more than the 20-second window, observes bounded backoff/attempt count, enters degraded monitoring and does not kill or terminalize the still-live process.
Unit: degraded monitoring retries later and a success restores normal cadence; a process that exits during degradation lets the monitor return without a spurious terminal proposal.
Unit: typed STALE_EXECUTION and RECOVERY_HORIZON_EXPIRED branches remain byte-for-byte or behaviorally unchanged; unknown 4xx is still fatal.

Actual PostgreSQL 17 two-worker 500/operator-loss-200 case with an injected first renewal 500 completes, preserves accepted 200, resumes at 201, replaces only the intended child and ends Flow/deployment/tag/physical slots at zero.
Actual non-injected 500/operator-loss-200 successor passes on the frozen correction cut. The hosted failing selector is rerun when published CI is available.
Before/after source map, actual imported paths/PIDs/start ticks, raw server/worker logs, JUnit and durable exits are captured. No fresh pass is rebound to the historical hosted bytes.

authorization.basis: Routine correction within the already approved and accepted fixed-P2 slice; Root and architect explicitly approved the renewal-only successor.

causal_boundary: The hosted run proves a real untyped renewal 500 can abort the launcher monitor and strand the current physical allocation.
The isolated pass observed FlowRun lock waits up to 2.948401 seconds but did not identify the blocker transaction. No deadlock or NI2-010 product regression is claimed.
Renewal/monitor/test bytes are identical to the previously accepted fixed-P2 cut; this is a latent resilience correction, not evidence that routed-DAG code caused the failure.

hosted_failure.result: 500-operator-loss-200 failed after one renewal HTTP500; PostgreSQL recorded a client-cancelled FlowRun FOR UPDATE waiter; four tag slots remained and seven later cases failed setup.

isolated_successor.result: The unchanged exact 500/operator-loss-200 case passed 1/1 in 96.07s, resumed at 201 after accepted 200 and ended with deployment/tag/physical slots zero. The contention trigger was not reproduced.

forbidden_changes: retry budgets for DATA or non-renew control methods
fixed-P2 routing, worker or capacity protocol
implementation.temporary_fault_harness: Build the actual-process injection in an owned temporary harness first. Move only the proven minimal control into the repository after source/hash review.

invariants: A heartbeat response is advisory liveness evidence. Missing or untyped 5xx evidence is not authority to kill a still-live coordinator or report its Flow Crashed.
Only renew_native_stream_launch is added to the retry rule, and only StreamRequestError(code=HTTP_ERROR,status=500..599) plus the already supported transport error qualifies.
Every retry uses the identical flow_run_id, generation and enrollment_operation_id. The server operation only advances last_renewed_at, so lost-ack replay is idempotent.
The existing 20-second retry budget is retained. No timeout is increased.
Retries use bounded backoff (initial at least 0.1 seconds, capped at 1 second) and a monotonic deadline; no tight or unbounded hammer loop is permitted.

After the bounded renewal window exhausts, _monitor records a credential-free degraded-renewal warning, leaves renewed_at unchanged and continues monitoring the still-live process after a bounded retry delay. It does not raise out of the TaskGroup, kill the coordinator, propose Crashed or release physical slots.

Typed STALE_EXECUTION still kills the stale coordinator and returns. Typed RECOVERY_HORIZON_EXPIRED and RECOVERY_NOT_READY retain their existing fail-closed behavior. Other 4xx and programming errors are not swallowed.
A later successful renewal clears the degraded observation and resumes the ordinary ten-second renewal cadence.
open_boundary: True coordinator death, persistent authority outage and cross-host takeover/cleanup remain ADR-0047. This correction neither claims nor implements a general active-P2 cancellation or whole-worker recovery protocol.
scope: A narrow fixed-P2 launcher renewal correction in _starter_native.py plus existing runner unit tests and one actual-process fault successor. No generic SDK/API/server/DDL change.
